items.title: Parity-conditional rank possibilities for elliptic curves y^2=x^3-2pqx classified by prime residue and quadratic symbol
items.author: Arkabrata Ghosh; Bidisha Roy; Richa Sharma
items.difficulty_reason: One complete residue-class classification of the two-prime elliptic family requires both 2-isogeny descents, integral quartic homogeneous-space solvability/obstruction analysis across the prime/sign/2-adic cases, quadratic reciprocity and the original root-number/parity conclusion. All four original theorem branches retained together, including the explicit Parity Conjecture assumption in the immediately preceding author context. Old oalpha_3.1 is one local support lemma, not the full classification. Unconditional special-case theorem and original Sage example tables retained without extra counts or recomputation.

primary.label: Complete original four residue/symbol branches combined as one rank-possibility classification

proof_spans.label: Complete original descent/2-adic and prime-local quartic cases, root-number and parity proofs of all four main branches

contexts.label: Original two-prime elliptic family and explicit Parity Conjecture assumption for all four main branches
Original example tables and unconditional-special-case statement retained uncounted
